title.value: pkg Pages: one install-<ch>.sh per channel that converges the box from any starting state

body.value:
Part of #2416 (meta #2411 item 1b). Closes #2445 (conf header wording folded in). #2416 stays open until the first published cycle lands.

## What

One published client entry point per channel — `<base>/install-{stable,testing,edge,nightly}.sh` — replaces the `add-repo.sh` + `migrate-channel.sh` two-step on the landing page. Each is a thin channel file (`scripts/channel-install/install-<ch>.sh`) whose shared body (`install-common.sh`) and the rc.d repo-conf hook are embedded by `gen_landing.py` at website-build time, so the published file is self-contained and runs as `fetch -qo - <base>/install-<ch>.sh | sh`.

The script is an idempotent state machine over `pkg query -g '%n' 'pfSense-pkg-pfBlockerNG*'`:

| Box state | Action |
| --- | --- |
| nothing installed | subscribe → `pkg install -y -r pfblockerng-<ch> pfSense-pkg-pfBlockerNG` |
| canonical, this repo, offered version | reported no-op (zero package operations) |
| canonical, this repo other version / any other repo (Netgate, legacy `pfblockerng`, other channel) | `pkg install -y -f -r pfblockerng-<ch> pfSense-pkg-pfBlockerNG-<offered>`; cross-release-family downgrade prints a warning first, then proceeds |
| any suffixed identity (`-devel`, `-NIGHTLY`, …) | `pkg delete -y <it>` then install canonical from the channel |

Every step is check-then-act (hook bytes, conf presence/marker, retired peer confs, installed identity/`%R`/`%v`), other project confs are retired only after the target catalogue is proven, every `pkg` call is `-y` with stdin from `/dev/null` (the script's stdin is the pipe), and the post-verify contract from `migrate-channel.sh` carries over unchanged (exactly the canonical identity, `%R` = target repo, `%v` = offered, `pkg info -l` payload present, config section preserved). Exit codes 0/1/2/4/5/6 by failure class. Offered version is picked with `pkg version -t` (#2393 residual). **Owner ruling (alpha): `add-repo.sh` and `migrate-channel.sh` are removed outright** with their tests — `install-<ch>.sh` is the sole client entry point for subscribe, install, upgrade and switch. `gen_landing.py` derives the manual-conf snippet from `build-repo-portable.py --print-conf`; `publish-pkg-repo.sh` publishes the four installers, refreshes them on the catalogue-NOOP path, and fails closed when one is missing. The rc.d hook no longer regenerates a leftover legacy `pfblockerng.conf` (#2384 residual) and the conf header reads `re-run install-<channel>.sh to change` in every remaining producer.

## Proof

- `tests/test_channel_install.py` (35): every state row above, idempotent second runs, resume after a partial run, reverse-catalogue-order version pick, empty catalogue / update failure leave peers untouched, verify failures, config-section loss, no-flags contract, piped run, and a direct `_pkg` stdin-isolation test.
- `tests/test_gen_landing.py` (+11, red→green): one-line card, unpublished suppression (#2382 residual), self-contained published installer runs piped with embedded hook + common, `--client-scripts-only` writes all six.
- `tests/shell/publish_pkg_repo_spec.sh` (red→green): six-file staging; a drift in only `install-edge.sh` still commits.
- Guest smoke (real FreeBSD `/bin/sh` + `pkg`, file:// channel catalogues, script piped through `fetch -qo - … | sh`): fresh box ×2 channels (installed hook byte-identical to the shipped hook), legacy `-devel`, channel-to-channel down and back up, non-project-origin canonical, unpublished target refused without touching the box — each converged state re-run and asserted a no-op. #2151 (live any→any over Pages) stays the follow-up.

Independent per-step verifier gates (small tier) recorded in the session. Review round 1 (three legs + CodeRabbit) findings and their fixes are in commit `43503995`'s message; the first guest run caught a real defect (a refused run against another base re-pointed a peer conf through the hook) fixed red→green in `ed359c69`.
